headline: Cell-type-resolved molecular readouts and perturbation capture ground regulatory variant interpretation
label: Regulatory Variant Effect Modeling
summary: New single-cell, long-read and epigenomic methods resolve edits, methylation and chromatin state by cell type, giving finer context for regulatory effects.
synthesis: The current items do not contain sequence-to-activity variant-effect models; the shared thread is experimental and resource-level cell-type resolution of regulatory state. Superb-seq links Cas9 on- and off-target edits to single-cell expression changes in K562, a direct readout of perturbation effects. TrES-seq pairs scRNA-seq with nanobody-Tn5 histone mark profiling (H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K9me3), and COMET assigns bulk long reads to cell types by methylation. A single-cell lncRNA atlas across 18 cancer types links lncRNAs to regulons and CRISPR screens. The heart isoform atlas (15,535 novel isoforms), Siphon-seq platelet transcriptome and ScarX fibrosis ranking are adjacent transcriptome resources, not variant-effect models. Together they supply context-specific ground truth for training and validating regulatory variant predictors.
